---
title: "`ev_idmap_report()` — UniProt→symbol mapping summary"
---

## Purpose

Retrieve the UniProt-accession-to-gene-symbol mapping report that
`ev_validate()` / `ev_read_contrasts()` attach when the input is UniProt-first,
so you can audit how many accessions actually resolved.

## When to use

After validating or reading UniProt-keyed input, to check mapping coverage and
inspect the accessions that failed before trusting enrichment results. Returns
`NULL` for symbol-based input (nothing was mapped).

## How it works

During validation, accessions are looked up against the bundled per-species
table (isoform `-N` suffixes stripped for lookup only; secondary accessions
resolve to the primary entry and are flagged). The resulting per-accession
table is summarised into a list and stored as the `ev_idmap_report` attribute.
This function simply returns that attribute. The report carries:

- `n_input`, `n_mapped`, `n_unmapped`
- `n_isoform_stripped` — accessions matched after dropping an isoform suffix
- `n_via_secondary` — accessions resolved through a secondary→primary link
- `unmapped` — the accessions that found no symbol

## Parameters & defaults

| Argument | Default | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `x` | *(required)* | a tibble from `ev_validate()` / `ev_read_contrasts()` |

## Literature

No method-specific citation; see [methods](../methods.qmd).

## Example

```r
v <- ev_validate(uniprot_res, species = "rat")
rep <- ev_idmap_report(v)
rep$n_mapped / rep$n_input      # mapping coverage
head(rep$unmapped)              # accessions to investigate
```
